networkPolicy.desc: Facebook, LogRocket and Microsoft Clarity are blocked; the application stays open

notes: Written from the binary and from the tunnel. React Native with Mapbox and Google Maps. What it needs: prod.api.grivo-cloud.net, prod.payplus.grivo-cloud.net, grivo.co.il, Mapbox and Firebase. Blocked: the Facebook SDK, and two session recorders, LogRocket and Microsoft Clarity, which record what is on the screen.
